acceptance_boundaries.no_timeout_summation: Renderer grant is the only budget; Main and gateway RPC clamp to what remains (verified by tests).
acceptance_boundaries.late_success: An expired deadline fails closed before the action starts; the renderer fallback fires from the same budget.
acceptance_boundaries.provider_slot: The outbound slot still releases only on a real end/cancel/error event (provider-outbound-budget suite re-run).
acceptance_boundaries.long_actions: Whitelist budgets are preserved but clamped to the caller deadline; no default changed.
acceptance_boundaries.gateway_wire_deadline: Not claimed: the deadline is host-request metadata, not a gateway wire protocol field. Main-side gateway RPCs are clamped; a gateway-side absolute deadline would need a protocol field.
acceptance_boundaries.provider_deadline: Not claimed: the provider leg keeps AbortSignal cancellation plus its own provider timeout (TF-0438 wiring); no absolute provider-side deadline is propagated.
